decks.notes: This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early on by playing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex. It also aims to control the board by using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude. The deck utilizes artifacts like Urza's Saga and Chrome Mox to ramp up quickly and generate value through cards like Esper Sentinel. With a mix of aggro threats and control elements, this deck aims to stay ahead in the game and secure victory through initiative and board control.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells. By combining powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Delver of Secrets with disruptive spells like Daze and Stifle, the deck aims to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find key cards, while also running a few resilient threats like Murktide Regent to close out games. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive in order to gain an advantage and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying disruptive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while using accelerants like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to enable a fast start. The deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's options with cards like Chalice of the Void, while also having ways to deal with threats through cards like Solitude. The deck has a focused game plan of applying pressure early and maintaining control throughout the game.

The main concept of this Combo - Reanimator Legacy deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, then bring them back to the battlefield with spells like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck aims to cheat out creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Serra's Emissary to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. Additionally, cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize are included to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo pieces. The deck sacrifices consistency for explosiveness and aims to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to use Cascade mechanics to cast powerful spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with a constant stream of threats while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells. By combining Aggro elements with Cascade abilities, the deck aims to quickly deploy threats and maintain control of the game through tempo advantage. The inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent further enhances the deck's ability to adapt to different situations and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the key pieces needed for the Mystic Forge combo to generate infinite mana and card advantage. By using cards like Basalt Monolith, Grim Monolith, and Mesmeric Orb to fuel Mystic Forge's ability, players can dig deep into their library until they find a win condition like Walking Ballista. Defense Grid and Pithing Needle help protect the combo while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to create a powerful engine that overwhelms opponents with its card advantage and mana generation.

This deck aims to win quickly by using powerful disruption spells like Hymn to Tourach and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes cards like Baleful Strix and Brazen Borrower to control the board and maintain tempo. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and disrupt their strategy to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly set up a board presence using artifact cards like Urza's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Chalice of the Void. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist are key cards that help generate value from artifacts and create a token army. Urza's Saga provides additional mana ramp and tutoring. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Pithing Needle to control the tempo of the game. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive artifact strategies in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while establishing card advantage and board control through cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, Narset, Parter of Veils, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Hullbreacher. It also utilizes various forms of card draw and filtering with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Shark Typhoon, while also having access to board wipes like Supreme Verdict. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent by efficiently answering threats and deploying powerful threats of its own.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Bomberman combo of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana, allowing for powerful plays such as casting Walking Ballista for lethal damage. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Elite Spellbinder to control the opponent's game plan. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and flexibility with access to the sideboard, while Urza's Saga acts as a powerful tutor engine to find key pieces for the combo. The deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play. The key strategy is to get the legendary demon Griselbrand onto the battlefield as quickly as possible, allowing the player to draw a massive amount of cards and gain a substantial advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Unmask and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combos.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Bridge from Below, then use cards like Dread Return to bring back powerful creatures like Ashen Rider or Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. By utilizing cards like Cephalid Coliseum and Careful Study, the deck aims to fuel its graveyard quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive combos and overwhelming board presence. The inclusion of cards like Narcomoeba and Ichorid helps to create a constant stream of creatures, while disruption cards like Cabal Therapy provide additional control options.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Hymn to Tourach and Grief, while also applying pressure with creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the board and quickly close out the game with efficient threats and removal spells, taking advantage of the powerful card advantage provided by cards like Baleful Strix and Brainstorm. The mana base is carefully crafted to provide consistent access to all three colors while also being able to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast spells like Tendrils of Agony, utilizing storm mechanics to win in a single turn. Burning Wish allows for additional flexibility in accessing key combo pieces from the sideboard. The inclusion of cards like Veil of Summer and Misty Rainforest helps protect the combo from disruption, while Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble provide card selection and advantage. Wishclaw Talisman and Galvanic Relay serve as additional tutors and card draw, further enabling the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Unmask. It then uses Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Exhume to bring these creatures back to the battlefield for a game-winning combo. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to control the opponent's hand and strategy. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate powerful creatures and overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the "Hammer Time" combo of Colossus Hammer and Stoneforge Mystic, allowing for massive damage output in a short amount of time. The key strategy involves using Puresteel Paladin to equip the hammer for free, while utilizing cards like Sigarda's Aid and Paradise Mantle for additional speed and consistency. The deck also includes disruption cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wasteland to control the board and protect the combo. The main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with swift, powerful attacks before they can effectively respond.
